const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, re
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.lint import MARKUP_RE, AT_TOKEN_RE, extract_format_tokens

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w48-20260928'
paths = ['mod-tome.lua', 'tome-ashes-urhrok.lua', 'tome-orcs.lua']
manifest = load_manifest()
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))

def load(path, logical):
    return loader.load_path(path, logical_path=logical)

def key(row):
    return (row.get('section'), row.get('source'), row.get('source_tag'))

def token_sig(text):
    return {
        'markup': Counter(MARKUP_RE.findall(text)),
        'at': Counter(AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(text)),
        'format': tuple(token.raw for token in extract_format_tokens(text)),
        'templates': tuple(re.findall(r'<\?=.*?\?>', text)),
    }

baseline_records = json.loads((task / 'BASELINE-records.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
workset = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['items']
candidate = json.loads((task / 'CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r0a1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['payload']['translation_snapshot']
work_by_rev = {x['entry_revision_identity']: x for x in workset}
expected_revs = set(work_by_rev)
confirmed = {
    '175effe253b96a8e948f7adbbc22e58dedd6fd5484d25e593bd7fbcadd9740c9',
    '633ee7605b9c379078bbd321cc06f2b56cad15f34ac77c1ba50ae6c8398d877d',
}
changed = []
metadata_drift = []
newline_violations = []
token_violations = []
current_maps = {}
loaded_current = 0
loaded_baseline = 0
for rel in paths:
    base_doc = load(task / 'baseline' / rel, rel)
    cur_doc = load(root / rel, rel)
    loaded_baseline += 1
    loaded_current += 1
    base_map = {key(x): x for x in base_doc.translations}
    cur_map = {key(x): x for x in cur_doc.translations}
    assert len(base_map) == len(base_doc.translations)
    assert len(cur_map) == len(cur_doc.translations)
    assert set(base_map) == set(cur_map), (rel, len(set(base_map) - set(cur_map)), len(set(cur_map) - set(base_map)))
    for k, b in base_map.items():
        c = cur_map[k]
        for field in ('function_name','kind','section','source','source_tag','args_order','special'):
            if b.get(field) != c.get(field):
                metadata_drift.append((rel, k, field))
        if b['target'] != c['target']:
            changed.append((rel, k))
            if b['target'].count('\n') != c['target'].count('\n'):
                newline_violations.append((rel, k))
            if token_sig(b['target']) != token_sig(c['target']):
                token_violations.append((rel, k))
    current_maps[rel] = cur_map
    base_bytes = (task / 'baseline' / rel).read_bytes()
    cur_bytes = (root / rel).read_bytes()
    assert b'\r' not in base_bytes and b'\r' not in cur_bytes, rel
    base_lines = base_bytes.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    cur_lines = cur_bytes.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    assert len(base_lines) == len(cur_lines), (rel, len(base_lines), len(cur_lines))
    for n, (a, bline) in enumerate(zip(base_lines, cur_lines), 1):
        assert re.match(r'^[ \t]*', a).group() == re.match(r'^[ \t]*', bline).group(), (rel, n)

changed_revs = set()
for rel, k in changed:
    matches = [rev for rev, item in work_by_rev.items() if item['normalized_path'] == rel and (item['section'], item['source'], item.get('source_tag')) == k]
    assert len(matches) == 1, (rel, k, matches)
    changed_revs.add(matches[0])
assert len(changed) == 22, len(changed)
assert changed_revs == expected_revs, (expected_revs - changed_revs, changed_revs - expected_revs)
assert not metadata_drift, metadata_drift
assert not newline_violations, newline_violations
assert not token_violations, token_violations

candidate_changed = []
candidate_newline_violations = []
candidate_token_violations = []
for snap in candidate:
    rev = snap['revision_key']
    item = work_by_rev[rev]
    k = (item['section'], item['source'], item.get('source_tag'))
    cur = current_maps[item['normalized_path']][k]
    if snap['target'] != cur['target']:
        candidate_changed.append(rev)
        if snap['target'].count('\n') != cur['target'].count('\n'):
            candidate_newline_violations.append(rev)
        if token_sig(snap['target']) != token_sig(cur['target']):
            candidate_token_violations.append(rev)
assert set(candidate_changed) == confirmed, candidate_changed
assert len(candidate_changed) == 2
assert not candidate_newline_violations
assert not candidate_token_violations

print(json.dumps({
    'luajit_loaded': {'baseline_files': loaded_baseline, 'current_files': loaded_current},
    'baseline_changed_targets': len(changed),
    'baseline_expected_workset_match': True,
    'baseline_metadata_drift': len(metadata_drift),
    'baseline_newline_violations': len(newline_violations),
    'baseline_markup_placeholder_violations': len(token_violations),
    'candidate_changed_targets': len(candidate_changed),
    'candidate_changed_revision_keys': sorted(candidate_changed),
    'candidate_newline_violations': len(candidate_newline_violations),
    'candidate_markup_placeholder_violations': len(candidate_token_violations),
    'lf_only_and_leading_whitespace_preserved': True,
}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
